# Synthetic Specimen 1: Damped Harmonic Oscillator
Differential Equation: m * x''(t) + gamma * x'(t) + k * x(t) = 0
Invariant: Hamiltonian energy decay rate dE/dt = -gamma * (x')^2 <= 0
QUOTE: "m * x''(t) + gamma * x'(t) + k * x(t) = 0"

# Synthetic Specimen 2: Series RLC Circuit
Differential Equation: L * q''(t) + R * q'(t) + (1/C) * q(t) = 0
Invariant: Dissipated power P(t) = -R * (q')^2 <= 0
QUOTE: "L * q''(t) + R * q'(t) + (1/C) * q(t) = 0"
